title.zh: CrowdStrike: Hackers Target South Korean Financial Institutions Using LLMs and A
title.en: CrowdStrike: Hackers Target South Korean Financial Institutions Using LLMs and A

current_state.zh: CrowdStrike says an unidentified threat actor used the open-source AI pentesting tool ARTEX and multiple LLMs to breach several South Korean financial institutions, including KB Kookmin, Shinhan and Hana Bank, exfiltrating personal data of 68,000 individuals.
current_state.en: CrowdStrike says an unidentified threat actor used the open-source AI pentesting tool ARTEX and multiple LLMs to breach several South Korean financial institutions, including KB Kookmin, Shinhan and Hana Bank, exfiltrating personal data of 68,000 individuals.
